Silymarin as a phytopharmaceutical agent: advances in mechanistic insights, formulation strategies, and pre-clinical applications

Stress and survival signalling pathway (a) Inhibition of the MAPK–p38 pathway: Silymarin reduces phosphorylation of p38 MAPK, by attenuating inflammatory responses, while in cancer cells it can shift the balance toward apoptosis and growth suppression; (b) JAK/STAT suppression: Silymarin inhibits Janus kinase–mediated activation and nuclear translocation of signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) proteins, leading to decreased expression of genes involved in proliferation, angiogenesis, and survival
Download JPG
